{{Quote|I am Master Ni-Cada. And this is Padawan Lo Bukk.|Ni-Cada, talking to Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
'''Lo Bukk''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], he and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Ni-Cada]], were sent by the Order to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Abraxin]] to investigate the continuous killing of [[marsh haunt]]s, which were being carried out by the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Naat Lare]]. On the planet the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] unknowingly crossed paths with the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], who was also looking for Lare. After Plagueis managed to make contact with Lare, the Muun convinced him into taking the offense against the Jedi as proof of his worthiness to join the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]; the resulting [[Duel on Abraxin|skirmish]] was short, in which Bukk's Master [[Death/Legends|killed]] Lare.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master?''"<br />"''It's done. He's dead.|Lo Bukk and Ni-Cada, after the latter killed Naat Lare|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
Lo Bukk was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Ni-Cada]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[67 BBY/Legends|forty-five]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a series of conflicts fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He and Ni-Cada were sent by the Order to the swampy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abraxin]] in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], to investigate the continuous [[Death/Legends|killing]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[marsh haunt]]s,<ref name="Darth P" /> who were [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], gray-and-green-skinned creatures.<ref name="TCSE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The marsh haunt killings were committed by [[Naat Lare]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]]. Lare had been selected by [[Darth Venamis]], a prospective male [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the lineage of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], as a potential [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="Darth P" />

During their stay on Abraxin, the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] Sith Lord [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] passed by Bukk and Ni-Cada disguised while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were bargaining with a [[Unidentified Barabel (Abraxin)|member]] of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]]<ref name="Darth P" /> [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;cold-blooded reptilians from the world [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]&mdash;<ref name="TCSE" /> for a [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]]. Both of them [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] Plagueis' presence, though neither identified him as a Sith, an order of Force-sensitives who utilized the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Later, as Bukk and his master emerged from an [[Unidentified eatery (Abraxin)|eatery]] bearing flagons of liquid, they unknowingly crossed paths with Darth Plagueis once again, and later talked with the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]], who was also looking for Lare, as they sat at a table and discussed with the Muun about the recent killing of marsh haunts. Plagueis managed to make contact with Lare and convinced him into striking against the Bukk and his master as proof of Lare's worthiness to join the Sith. The Jedi tracked Lare with the skimmer, and a short [[Duel on Abraxin|skirmish]] ensued after the Nautolan attacked the two near the water, during which Lare was killed by Bukk's master.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|And what brings the Jedi to Abraxin, Master Ni-Cada? Not the shellfish, I take it." <br /> "We're investigating the recent killing of marsh haunts.|Plagueis and Lo Bukk|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
Lo Bukk had a more of a open attitude than his master, as he easily divulged the nature of the Jedi's mission to Plagueis, though his master tried to hide the reason of their mission. When the Muun Sith Lord Darth Plagueis passed by under disguise, both Ni-Cada and Lo Bukk felt Plagueis' presence, though neither of them identified him as a Sith, a sect of Force-sensitives who utilized the dark side of the Force.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lo Bukk's first and currently only appearance to date is the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]]. The novel tells the backstory of Darth Plagueis.<ref name="Darth P" /> Though not confirmed in the novel, Lo Bukk was possibly named after the [[Bukk]] animal, as many Zabrak families were named after them.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
